title: 第17章 寇可往我亦可往第18章 小小见面礼希望公主你喜欢
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
姜无涯看了一眼漫天飞舞的寿衣怨灵。
知道这是鬼修的手段。
鬼修拥有附身操控手段，不足为奇。
“操控本尊的尸骨又如何，旁人不是傻子，以主上在隐龙城的声望，不会有人轻信污蔑之言。”姜无涯无比笃定这一点。
“夜洐，你的一切在主上眼中，都是无能狂怒，哈哈哈。”
一阵阴风阵阵。
被厉鬼背负的怨鬼来到夜洐面前。
“大人，在巡夜司地下发现密室，发现一个特殊的人。”怨鬼汇报最新发现。
怨鬼任务不是杀戮。
是寻找巡夜司各处机密，保护宝物，保护经法。
可操控厉鬼穿墙遁地的怨鬼，最适合这项任务。
“谁？”
“伤痕累累，在刑具上的一个男人，位于这位掌使大人院中地下。”
夜洐低头。
看着神色骤变的姜无涯。
“出场时，你手背染血，正在对他人行刑，一直喋喋不休，激怒我，其一目的是为了掩盖地下密室。”夜洐好奇道：“谁值得你大动干戈私下用刑，应该不是惩罚，而是逼问某个秘密，可对。”
姜无涯紧闭嘴巴，一言不发。
“带上来。”
很快。
怨鬼操控厉鬼，带来一个伤痕累累的男人。

此人，夜洐不认识。
但身上穿的也是巡夜司的玄服。
“邪魔作乱，屠杀巡夜司。”男人难以置信看着巡夜司，又看到被夜洐拖拽的姜无涯，瞳孔紧缩，忍不住道：“掌使大人，我早就说过多行不义必自毙，报应，这是报应，这是老天对我们巡夜司的惩罚。”
话语中有哀痛，更有畅快之意。
姜无涯怒吼道：“李策，你闭嘴，自诩正义的你，如果心有正义，现在立即以消灭邪魔为己任。”
“正义，被你唾弃嘲讽的正义？”李策忍不住自嘲。
夜洐看着李策，询问道：“多行不义必自毙，巡夜司做了什么不义之事。”
“闭.....”
“给你脸了是吧。”夜洐不耐烦一脚踩在大喊大叫姜无涯脑袋之上，用力碾了碾，让他嘴巴跟地面来了最亲密的接触，满嘴是土。
“我们继续，我最喜欢声张正义了。”夜洐微笑的看着浑身一抖的李策。
后者看着满地的尸骨。
死死咬着牙齿。
似乎不愿意跟夜洐多说什么。
“我喜欢配合，你的魂魄应该没有什么封印，境界才二境，我不想用强，不想让怨鬼直接夺舍你的魂魄，吞掉你的一切，得到你的记忆。”
淡淡的话语，让李策毛骨悚然。
“旱灾是人为的，是王府所为，有多个世家豪族是帮凶，目的是为了催熟宝物，宝物已经被王府所得。”沉默数息的李策开口道：
“我发现了证据，铁证如山，我查到了所有细节，知道一切线索，我只想给无辜受灾之人一个公道。”
“可惜，我做不到。”
李策眼含热泪。
不甘与自责。
content_en:
Jiang Wuya glanced at the resentful spirits flying in the shrouds.
I know this is the method of ghost cultivators.
It’s not surprising that ghost cultivators have the means to control possession.
"So what if you control my body? Others are not fools. With my Lord's reputation in Hidden Dragon City, no one will believe the slander." Jiang Wuya was extremely sure of this.
"Ye Hui, in the eyes of the Lord, everything about you is just incompetence and rage, hahaha."
A gust of wind blew.
The resentful ghost who was carried by the evil ghost came to Ye Hui.
"Sir, a secret room was discovered underground in the Night Watch Department, and a special person was discovered." The resentful ghost reported the latest discovery.
The mission of the resentful ghost is not to kill.
It is to search for the secrets of the Night Watch Department, protect the treasures, and protect the scriptures.
The resentful ghost, which can control the evil ghost to pass through walls and escape to the ground, is the most suitable for this task.
"Who?"
"A man with many scars on a torture device is located underground in the courtyard of the Lord Envoy."
Ye Xi lowered his head.
Looking at Jiang Wuya's sudden change of expression.
"When you appeared, the back of your hand was stained with blood, and you were executing others. You kept chattering and irritating me. One of the purposes was to cover up the underground secret room." Ye Tao asked curiously: "Who deserves you to go to war and torture in private? It should not be punishment, but to ask for a secret, right."
Jiang Wuya shut his mouth tightly and said nothing.
"Bring it up."
Soon.
The resentful ghost controlled the fierce ghost and brought a scarred man.
Ye Hui doesn't know this person.
But he was also wearing the mysterious clothes of the Night Watch Division.
"Evils made trouble and massacred the Night Watch Division." The man looked at the Night Watch Division in disbelief, and then saw Jiang Wuya being dragged by Ye Hu, his pupils tightened, and he couldn't help but said: "Master Commander, I have long said that those who do too much injustice will be punished by death. Retribution, this is retribution, this is God's punishment for our Night Patrol Division."
There is sadness in the words, but also a sense of joy.
Jiang Wuya roared angrily: "Li Ce, shut up. You who claim to be righteous, if you have justice in your heart, you should immediately take it as your duty to destroy the evil spirits."
"Justice, the justice you spurn and ridicule?" Li Ce couldn't help laughing at himself.
Ye Tao looked at Li Ce and asked, "Anyone who commits many unjust acts will be punished by his own death. What unjust thing did the Night Patrolman do?"
"Close..."
"I'll give you some face, right?" Ye Tao impatiently stepped on the head of the yelling Jiang Wuya, and crushed him hard, causing his mouth to come into the most intimate contact with the ground, and his mouth was full of dirt.
"Let's continue. I like to speak out for justice." Ye Tao smiled and looked at Li Ce, who was shaking all over.
The latter looked at the corpses on the ground.
Gritting his teeth tightly.
He seemed unwilling to say anything more to Ye Hui.
"I like to cooperate. There shouldn't be any seal on your soul. You are only in the second realm. I don't want to use force. I don't want the resentful ghost to directly seize your soul, swallow everything about you, and get your memories."
The faint words made Li Ce's hair stand on end.
"The drought is man-made. It was caused by the palace. There are many aristocratic families who are accomplices. The purpose is to ripen the treasure. The treasure has been obtained by the palace." Li Ce, who was silent for a few breaths, said:
"I found the evidence, which is ironclad. I found all the details and knew all the clues. I just want to give justice to the innocent victims."
"Unfortunately, I can't do it."
Li Ce had tears in his eyes.
Reluctance and self-blame.
